lines: I can vouch for {player}. Keep the {container} tidy and take only what you need.
{player} helped repair our farms after the last attack. I trust them near our stores.
Let them look. Someone who defended this village deserves a little faith.
I know those hands. They have brought more into the village than they have ever taken.
They asked for our trust once and proved worthy of it. Give them room.
I'll answer for {player} if anything goes missing.
Leave the lid open. I want to hear what they are looking for.
That {container} holds supplies, not secrets. Let {player} check it.
We know this traveler. There is no need to treat them like a stranger.
I saw what {player} did for our neighbors. They have earned the benefit of the doubt.
Let them take a fair share. They have shared plenty with us.
I trust {player} to put back anything they do not use.
Stand easy. Their visits have never left our stores worse off.
Give them a moment at the {container}. I'll stay and make sure all is well.
The village owes {player} more than a suspicious stare.
They came openly, not sneaking through the shadows. Let them search.
I would speak against a thief. Today, I am speaking for {player}.
Keep watch if you must, but do not shame someone who has stood beside us.
The {container} can be sorted again. Earned trust is harder to mend.
I will <pulse>vouch</pulse> for {player}. Let their good name count for something.
Not this time, {player}. Close the {container} and ask before reaching.
I trust you, but those supplies were counted for another family.
Friends still knock before walking through a door. Village stores are no different.
That {container} is under my care today, so the answer is no.
Your good name does not give you leave to search every chest.
Step back for now. I can find what you need if you tell me.
I am not accusing you of theft. I am asking you to respect our rules.
Some things in there are private, even from people we trust.
The village promised those goods elsewhere. Please leave them alone.
You have standing here, but no one offered you the contents of that {container}.
Close the lid. We can settle this with a conversation.
I know you mean well. That does not make this the right store to open.
Permission matters most when we expect someone to grant it.
That latch is not a test of our friendship. Leave it shut.
People trust me to guard this {container}. I will not break my word for you.
Ask the owner, {player}. My trust cannot replace theirs.
There is nothing in there meant for you today.
You are welcome in the village, but not inside every cupboard.
Wait here while I check whether any of those supplies can be spared.
I trust you enough to be honest. <pulse>Close it</pulse>.
Stand down. If {player} needs the {container}, we should hear them out.
Our liege has guarded this village through worse than an open chest.
Let them look. The village has already placed far more in their hands.
{player} has earned our faith in battle and in peace.
Those stores exist to serve the village, just as our ruler does.
Do not greet our liege with an accusation over a lifted latch.
If something there can help {player} protect us, it is well spent.
Give them room. Royal duty does not stop at the door of a storehouse.
The village chose to trust {player}. This is hardly the moment to forget.
I would rather ask what our liege needs than assume the worst.
Let the {container} open. We owe its contents to the safety {player} provides.
Remember who stood between us and the raiders before you object.
Perhaps our ruler knows of a need we have not heard about yet.
That chest belongs to the village, and our liege carries the village's burdens.
Put away that suspicion. {player} has never treated our trust lightly.
We can count the supplies afterward. Show our liege some respect now.
Royal hands are not common thieves creeping through our stores.
Listen first. There may be good reason for opening that {container}.
Our liege has given us courage. We can return a measure of trust.
{player} has the village's <pulse>trust</pulse>. Let them pass.
If {previous_villager} vouches for you, I will stand down. Keep the {container} tidy.
All right, {player}. I trust {previous_villager}'s judgment.
I did not know someone had given you permission. Carry on.
Then take only what you came for and leave the rest in order.
I will accept their word, but I am staying until the lid closes.
{previous_villager} has never misled me about a guest.
That changes matters. Tell me if you need help finding anything.
I spoke before hearing the whole story. You may continue.
If they are willing to answer for you, I have no cause to interfere.
Very well. I would rather trust a neighbor than prolong an argument.
You may continue. {previous_villager} has taken responsibility for this.
I can see they mean it. My objection ends here.
Then there is no quarrel between us, {player}.
I was guarding the stores, not looking for a fight. We are settled.
Go ahead, but do not make {previous_villager} regret speaking up.
The {container} can stay open. Please put everything back where you found it.
I know when to listen to someone I respect. Thank you, {previous_villager}.
I will step aside and let their promise speak for you.
No offense was meant, {player}. I only needed a reason to trust this.
{previous_villager}'s word is enough. Keep the {container} <pulse>tidy</pulse>.
As you say. The {container} is open to our liege.
Forgive my suspicion, {player}. I should have recognized you.
I will step aside. Take whatever the village can spare.
Of course our ruler may inspect the stores.
I spoke too quickly, my liege. There is no challenge here.
The village entrusted far more than a chest to you.
Please continue. I will make sure no one else interrupts.
Your need comes before my worry over a few supplies.
I understand now. The {container} is at your disposal.
No permission of mine could add to the authority you already carry.
Take what will help you keep the village safe.
I meant to guard our stores, not question our ruler.
The fault is mine. I let caution hide your face from me.
If you need help carrying anything, you have only to ask.
Our liege does not need to justify every opened cupboard.
I will close the lid when you are finished, {player}.
The village stands behind you, and so do I.
Use what is there as you judge best.
My doubts are answered. The way is clear.
As you wish. Our <pulse>trust</pulse> goes with you.
Yes, <aqua>{previous_villager}</aqua> is right. I saw you take {stolen_item_reference} too.
I watched {stolen_count} {stolen_count_word} leave {stolen_container} in your hands.
Put {stolen_stack} <pulse>back</pulse>. There is no use denying it now.
I was beside the doorway when you reached inside.
Those {stolen_items} did not wander out of storage on their own.
I have witnessed this {witnessed_container_thefts} {container_theft_time_word} now.
You were caught {container_theft_again_phrase}, and this time there are two witnesses.
More than one pair of eyes followed you from that {stolen_container}.
I know what was stored there before you arrived.
<shake>Do not lie</shake> when half the village saw what happened.
I heard the latch and turned in time to see {stolen_item_pronoun}.
<aqua>{previous_villager}</aqua> does not stand alone. I will give the same account.
The missing goods are right there with you, <purple>{player}</purple>.
Return {stolen_stack} before this becomes a matter for the guard.
I helped count that store this morning. {stolen_count} {stolen_count_word} are gone.
Your pockets will not change what my eyes saw.
Set {stolen_item_pronoun} down and admit the truth.
I saw you leave {stolen_container} with {stolen_items}.
Arguing with <aqua>{previous_villager}</aqua> will not erase another witness.
You can still make this right by putting back what you took.
<aqua>{previous_villager}</aqua> is not exaggerating. I saw {stolen_stack} leave {stolen_container}.
I was close enough to recognize {stolen_item_reference} in your hands.
<pulse>Return</pulse> {stolen_stack}, <purple>{player}</purple>. We both know where it came from.
Two of us watched the same theft from different sides of the room.
That {stolen_container} was full before you opened it.
I followed you outside and never lost sight of {stolen_stack}.
Do not ask <aqua>{previous_villager}</aqua> to doubt their own eyes.
The village is watching now. Put everything back.
This is not a rumor passed between neighbors. I was there.
I can point to the exact place where {stolen_stack} belonged.
You hid your hands when I looked over. That told me plenty.
Count the store if you like. The empty space will prove our account.
I saw the lid close after you took what was inside.
The goods in your pack still bear the dust from that {stolen_container}.
Another denial will only make an honest return harder.
I called out before you reached the door, and you kept walking.
Set everything down before this gets <shake>worse</shake>.
One witness might miss a detail. Two witnesses did not invent the same scene.
I watched you walk from {stolen_container} to the door with full hands.
I am ready to tell the guard exactly what I saw.
I saw it too, <purple>{player}</purple>. Put {stolen_item_pronoun} back.
Three voices are telling the same story now.
I watched {stolen_items} cross the square from {stolen_container}.
Nobody here is guessing about those {stolen_count} {stolen_count_word}.
That makes another witness, and I will not stay quiet.
The crowd noticed when you tried to hide {stolen_stack}.
Every path away from that store had someone watching.
This stopped being a misunderstanding two witnesses ago.
Put {stolen_item_pronoun} back before the whole square gathers.
<shake>Enough.</shake> Return what belongs to the village.
I heard the first warning and came to see for myself.
You cannot call all of us mistaken, <purple>{player}</purple>.
The empty place in {stolen_container} matches what you carry.
I saw you glance behind yourself after taking {stolen_stack}.
More villagers are arriving. Choose honesty while you still can.
I watched you open {stolen_container}. Your hands were full when you turned away.
No one coached me. I am telling you what happened.
Your denial is making the truth louder, not quieter.
Set down {stolen_stack} and let this end without a chase.
We all saw enough. The next voice you hear may belong to a guard.
<aqua>{previous_villager}</aqua> is right. That {container} is village property, <purple>{player}</purple>.
I heard the lid and came over. Step back while we sort this out.
You need permission before searching village stores.
I am saying the same thing. Close {container} and explain what you need.
There is another witness now, so do not pretend no one noticed.
An unlocked latch is not an invitation.
If you need supplies, ask one of us to help.
The {container} is under village care, not open for travelers to browse.
Back away before a warning turns into a theft report.
Close it now while this can still end politely.
I was working nearby and saw exactly when you reached inside.
No one has called you a thief yet. Do not give us a reason.
That store was counted and sealed for village use.
Please take your hands out where we can see them.
Let the owner answer before you touch anything else.
Your reason may be harmless, but opening it without asking was not.
I can fetch the keeper if there is something you truly need.
Leave everything where it is until we know what happened.
<pulse>Step back</pulse> from {container}. We will listen once it is closed.
Two villagers have asked you now. Respect the warning.
<aqua>{previous_villager}</aqua> saw it, and so did I. <pulse>Close</pulse> {container}.
I was watching from the doorway, <purple>{player}</purple>.
This is not one neighbor making a careless accusation.
Ask before touching stores meant for the whole village.
You are not being singled out. You were seen opening it.
The supplies inside were gathered by many hands.
Do not make a simple boundary into an argument.
Step away and let the storekeeper check the contents.
If you only wanted to look, you can explain from over here.
Keep both hands clear of the {container}.
We remember who opens our cupboards without asking.
The owner may say yes, but that answer has not been given yet.
Someone could be relying on what is stored in there.
I will stand here until you close the lid.
The village shares willingly when people ask honestly.
Whatever brought you to that chest can wait one moment.
There are children nearby who learn from what they see.
Walking away now would show better sense than reaching deeper.
<shake>Now.</shake> Leave the {container} alone.
We have all heard enough excuses. Ask properly or move on.
Another voice will not change the rule. Close {container} and ask first.
More than one of us is <pulse>watching</pulse> now, <purple>{player}</purple>.
I saw enough to know you had no permission.
No one is piling on for sport. We are protecting shared supplies.
The answer stays no until the keeper says otherwise.
Close the lid before this becomes a worse conversation.
You have heard the boundary from several neighbors.
The village is no longer wondering who opened the store.
If you need something, name it and let us bring it out.
That {container} stays shut while ownership is in question.
The gathering crowd is a warning, not an audience.
Every moment you keep reaching in makes this harder to settle.
We are giving you one last chance to step away peacefully.
I will fetch the guard if you ignore everyone here.
Nothing inside is worth losing the village's trust.
The first warning was courtesy. This one is final.
You can still leave without being called a thief.
Show us that you understand by backing away now.
Let your hands fall to your sides, and we can talk.
Enough witnesses have spoken. The next choice is yours.
